question: Who among the following was awarded the Grand Collar of the Timor-Leste in August 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Droupadi Murmu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Droupadi Murmu**, the President of India, was awarded the **Grand Collar of the Order of Timor-Leste** in August 2024.
 
• This is the **highest civilian honor** of Timor-Leste, conferred to individuals for their significant contributions to strengthening bilateral ties.
 
• The honor was bestowed during her state visit to Timor-Leste, aimed at enhancing diplomatic and economic relations between the two nations.
 
• This was the first state visit by an Indian President to Timor-Leste, marking a historic milestone in India-Timor-Leste relations.
 
• The award reflects India’s growing global recognition and the emphasis placed on fostering international partnerships.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Grand Collar of the Order of Timor-Leste**:

 
 
• This is the highest distinction given by the Government of Timor-Leste to individuals who have significantly contributed to the country's development or international relations.
 
• Previous recipients include heads of state and other global leaders who have supported Timor-Leste's growth and international standing.
 
 
 
• **India-Timor-Leste Relations**:
 
 
• Diplomatic relations between India and Timor-Leste were established in 2003, shortly after Timor-Leste's independence in 2002.
 
• India has supported Timor-Leste in areas like capacity building, economic development, and infrastructure development.
 
 
 
• **Droupadi Murmu**:
 
 
• Droupadi Murmu is the 15th President of India and the first tribal woman to hold the office.
 
• She assumed office on July 25, 2022, and has been actively representing India on global platforms.
 
 
 
• **Timor-Leste**:
 
 
• Timor-Leste, also known as East Timor, is a Southeast Asian nation located on the eastern half of the island of Timor.
 
• It gained independence from Indonesia in 2002 and has since sought to strengthen its international diplomatic relationships.
